description: Santa Ana Winds Wildfire Threat Index is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by U.S. Forest Service (USFS). This threat index draws information from networks of weather observation sensors across Southern California to categorize the threat of wildfires over the next six days. The site provides real-time information about weather conditions and fuel moisture levels to help users understand the threat of wind-promoted wildfires across 4 regions (zones) of Southern California. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Wildfire. Assets: Energy and Utilities, Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
